defs.def: a strong feeling that sth/sb exists or is true; confidence that sth/sb is good or right 相信；信心

ex.s: They are likely to be influenced by social beliefs
ex.t: 他们很可能受到社会观念的影响。

ex.s: Through self-belief, hard work, perseverance and some help from an old hoop, he has shown that anything is possible.
ex.t: 通过自信、勤奋、毅力以及来自一个旧篮筐的帮助，他证明了没有不可能的事。

ex.s: With self-belief, hard work, determination and some help from the simple basket his grandfather built, Stephen has proved that nothing is impossible.
ex.t: 凭借自信、努力、决心，以及他祖父建造的简易篮筐的一些帮助，斯蒂芬证明了没有什么是不可能的。

defs.def: an opinion about sth; sth that you think is true 看法；信念

ex.s: For many years, psychologists saw identity as a combination of someone’s values, beliefs, goals and social roles.
ex.t: 多年来，心理学家把身份视为一个人的价值观、信念、目标和社交角色的结合。

ex.s: Although popular beliefs regarding emotional intelligence run far ahead of what research can reasonably support, the overall effects of the publicity have been more beneficial than harmful.
ex.t: 尽管关于情商的流行观点远远超出了目前研究能够支持的范围。

ex.s: Another way of setting realistic goals is to analyze your short and long term objectives, keeping in mind your beliefs, values and strengths.
ex.t: 设定现实目标的另一种方法是分析你的短期和长期目标，同时牢记你的信念、价值观和长处。

ex.s: So many of us have the belief that being comfortabel is the only state we will tolerate, and when we experience something outside of our comfort zone, we get impatient about the circumstances.
ex.t: 我们许多人都有这样的信念：舒适是唯一我们能容忍的状态，当我们经历舒适区之外的事时，就会对处境失去耐心。

ex.s: An opinion can be a general or individual view, belief or impression.
ex.t: 观点可以是一种普遍的或个人的看法、信念或印象。

defs.def: something that you believe, especially as part of your religion 信仰；宗教信仰

ex.s: When contributions were made by geniuses outside the club—women, or people of a different color or belief—they were unacknowledged and rejected by others.
ex.t: 当俱乐部之外的天才——女性，或不同肤色或信仰的人——做出贡献时，他们的贡献不被承认，反而被他人拒绝。

ex.s: My dance comes from their traditional belief and aims to bring out the Dai women's beauty.” 1 An art magazine.
ex.t: 我的舞蹈源自他们的传统信仰，旨在展现傣族女性的美。" 1 一本艺术杂志。

ex.s: I found that I was the only Chinese doctor among people of all ages, colours and beliefs, from every continent except Antarctica.
ex.t: 我发现我是来自除南极洲以外各大洲、各种年龄、肤色和信仰的人群中唯一的中国医生。

chunks.en: view / mind / values / social / popular / traditional belief
chunks.cn: 视野看法 / 头脑看法 / 价值看法 / 社会的看法 / 受欢迎的看法 / 传统的看法
